notes.title: Our major technical update, A Test Of Character, is out now!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/gGa4B7V.jpg

Discover new stories, fight new threats and do your best to stay undercover in this, our first free technical update! 

A Test Of Character includes over 10,000 words of written content, a brand new game feature and a significant overhaul to the way the game works.

We've overhauled the Clues system in both of our current stories, making it more obvious when and what you've done that might lead the Swiss Police to catch you. 

https://i.imgur.com/Ld93eBb.gif

These Clues are now reported in a revamped Field Report, along with how the Police picked up on them and a better visual representation of how close they are to catching you...

https://i.imgur.com/vDDpCzb.gif

This was in response to a great deal of feedback about the police system, which we were happy to address! We've also tweaked how often and where the police can catch you, with the aim of improving playability.

https://i.imgur.com/FitR9HS.jpg

We've also replaced the confusing system of clues on routes with Complications, our major new feature. These short stories test which stamps you've favoured in the game so far, and can lead to you dropping more Clues...

https://i.imgur.com/n1kmG9I.gif

Each Complication choice comes with a success or a failure story branch. We've added these to routes throughout our two stories, and made visual improvements to our game map to make it easier to use.

This update was a labour of love, as it involved rehauling some complicated systems, some serious gameplay testing and a ton of new written content to integrate with existing words.

We hope you enjoy A Test Of Character as much as we've enjoyed making it! Please let us know what you think and, if you did enjoy it, do leave us a review, as that helps our little games company out a great deal.

notes.title: Upcoming Technical Update: A Test of Character
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/09396affb7e73af98ddc6fdc426f6aa687ae4052.jpg

We at Stave Studios are pleased to announce that our next major update to Over the Alps, titled A TEST OF CHARACTER, will be a total overhaul of the existing “police pursuit” mechanic. As with our last major update, King of the Mountain, this patch will be totally free for everyone who owns the game.

We’ll go through our in-depth reasoning for making these changes at the end of this update, but first of all, here’s a quick preview of what you can expect!

OVERCOME UNEXPECTED CHALLENGES THAT TEST YOUR CHARACTER 

 As you travel the Routes in Over the Alps, you now have the chance to encounter COMPLICATIONS which impede your progress! 
 These obstacles must be overcome using one of the character traits that you’ve been building up over the course of the game. It’s time to start paying attention to your Stamps!
 The higher the Risk Level of your chosen Route, the more likely you are to find yourself in a spot of bother.
 Failure in the Complication means leaving a Footprint. The Police will start closing in!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/8373ba3bafaa66d45f5f4a15b056e396920fb578.jpg

KEEP TRACK OF THE CLUES YOU LEAVE BEHIND 

 The Footprints in Over the Alps are an abstraction of the clues you’re leaving, which the police can use to track you down. 
 In A TEST OF CHARACTER, each of the Footprints is now tracked individually, so you always know exactly how you messed up. Oops.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/10c1cd4f9988948ca5b0fa530fff07c92d18c648.jpg

PEEK AT THE NOTES OF THE POLICEMAN ON YOUR TAIL
You can now take a peek at the Police Notes to see exactly how close they are to catching you, and what they think of this English spy who’s been causing havoc in the peaceful Swiss countryside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/110cbe62582a23a8d213c96d06d7034e31447fb2.jpg

Why are we making these changes?

(Obligatory note of caution: Everything here is subject to change! We’re still in the process of implementing the new system, and there is extensive playtesting ahead of us. Take the following with a hefty grain of salt.)

After receiving feedback from our players on Steam and Apple Arcade, we felt that the previous implementation of the police pursuit had room for improvement.

Here’s a screenshot of the older system in action:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/292591fcc5b69be2fade6e374f43edd2423940bb.png

We found that players struggled to follow what was happening here. The Field Report pops up on screen and vanishes much too quickly, often resulting in a player not having time to process it. 

Even seasoned players still had trouble parsing the relationship between the Route Risk Level, the Footprints, and the police’s position on the tracker. 

Our solution is to introduce clarity by expanding on each of these elements, giving the player more information and (importantly) more time to process what was happening! 

Tracking the Footprints individually makes it super-clear what clues you left for the Police, and showing the Police Notes makes it obvious how close they are to catching you. The latter also provides an interesting third-person perspective on the player’s in-game decisions.

By far the greatest gameplay change is the addition of the Complications to Routes. We chose to add these for several reasons:


 Most importantly, it’s just fun! It adds a nice element of role-playing - your Spy may be better-equipped to deal with some Complications than others, depending on your choices and playstyle. You’ll always know beforehand which Routes test which characteristics, so choosing your Routes now requires some tactical thinking.
 It makes the Risk Level more relevant to gameplay. Only riskier Routes threaten to block your progress with a Complication.
 It increases the game’s replayability and adds something even for seasoned players to discover. Now there is even more optional content hidden behind many of the different Routes in the game.


Here’s a fancy flowchart of what the Spy’s journey down a particularly dangerous Route might look like after the Test of Character update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/9e9d67d57cc38fa6f863c465b866fc8b9a30cb61.png

Good luck, agents! It looks like your job just got a little more… complicated.

Roadmap

The Test of Character update is just one step in our dastardly long-term plan to provide you with more of the game you’ve already bought. Here’s a roadmap showing our planned upcoming content, and remember, all of this is free:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36869554/e5b3017bdf0f94397b1cad1b582a2f2aba7341af.png

What’s behind those intriguing redactions, you ask? Well, that’s a top-secret matter of national security, and a topic for another post. But I can assure you, the gears are turning. Ink is being spilled.

Over the Alps is not over yet.

PS: Over the Alps is in the Steam summer sale! You can grab yourself a copy now for 20% off.

notes.title: King of the Mountain: Free Full-length Story Update to Over the Alps, Out Now!
notes.notes:
The time has come, agent.

King of the Mountain, our new free full-length story update to Over the Alps, is being released today. Yes, you’re hearing that correctly, agent. It’s completely free for anyone who owns the original game, whether that be on Steam or on Apple Arcade.

King of the Mountain is set a year earlier than Over the Alps, in 1938, with war only a distant storm on the horizon. The intelligence services of Britain and Germany are arranging their pieces on the chessboard of Europe. 

Against this backdrop, you are playing as Annie Taylor, a British spy who has been reluctantly called away from Paris to attend the Swiss Grand Prix in Bern. She ends up in over her head, tangling with enemy Nazi agents, exchanging gunfire with Swiss yokels, and eventually being forced to take part in the Grand Prix herself...

For those who have played the original game, you may see some familiar places… and encounter some familiar faces. And if you haven’t downloaded the original Over the Alps yet, now’s the perfect time - you’ll get double the bang for your proverbial buck! Two stories for the price of one, and a third in the pipeline!

Check it out now - we hope you enjoy it! And don’t go falling into any lakes, you’ll catch your death...

notes.title: King of the Mountain: Free Update Coming 12th of June!
notes.notes:
Greetings agents,
                
This is a brief communiqué to all our most trusted operatives. Usually we tell you to burn this kind of thing after reading, but on this one instance, we'd like you to spread the word as wide as possible:

King of the Mountain is releasing 12th June!

[previewyoutube=uOCmRq1biwU;full][/previewyoutube]

King of the Mountain is a free new story expansion for Over the Alps.
                                      
The story takes place a year earlier than Over the Alps, in August 1938. Some say war is on the horizon… You will play as Annie Taylor, a British spy called away from the comforts of Paris to tackle an urgent assignment in Bern. 

https://i.imgur.com/knH2Wxz.gif

Over the course of your mission, you will attempt to infiltrate the Swiss Grand Prix, tangle with Nazis along the way, and you may end up going off the map entirely...
    
We've been working pretty hard on this one, and we're excited to finally release the next instalment in the Over the Alps anthology!

https://i.imgur.com/Ro89hGs.png                      

Spread the word!
